description: This Java class implements a strategy for handling the FeaturePropertyDeleted event in the context of Eclipse Ditto's thing persistence. It extends an abstract event strategy and overrides a method to modify a ThingBuilder based on the event details.

classes.name: FeaturePropertyDeletedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that handles FeaturePropertyDeleted events by removing the specified feature property from a thing builder.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to customize the handling of FeaturePropertyDeleted events by removing a feature property from the thing builder.
